categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in enterprise-level storage systems and specialized industrial-grade solid-state drives (SSDs). It serves key sectors including government, special industries, and industrial applications, focusing on high-performance storage solutions for AI, big data analytics, and cloud computing scenarios.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes自主可控 (independent controllability) technologies, developing PCIe 5.0 NVMe all-flash storage systems with distributed and centralized architectures. It integrates core technologies across the storage stack, including proprietary CPU platforms (e.g., FT5000), SSD controller chips, firmware algorithms, and solid-state storage hardware, supported by intelligent manufacturing and R&D centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Major customers are government entities and special industries, accounting for over 90% of revenue. The company targets '8+2' key industries and focuses on high-end applications such as AI large models, high-performance computing (HPC), and critical data center operations within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, with significant revenue from northern and eastern regions, and growing presence in western China. The company also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong, serving as an overseas operating entity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company occupies a midstream to downstream position in the storage supply chain, encompassing end-to-end storage system design, SSD manufacturing, and integration. It also invests in upstream component suppliers such as SSD controller chip and firmware developers, forming a vertically integrated storage ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include自主可控 (independent controllability), flash storage, and cloud computing. The company invests heavily in R&D (over 20% of revenue), focusing on PCIe 5.0 NVMe all-flash platforms, mixed flash storage, AIoT intelligent operation platforms, and ruggedized storage for harsh environments. It also pursues ecosystem collaboration with domestic CPU and software providers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of storage systems and solid-state storage products. The company operates a direct sales model, with a focus on large-scale contracts with government and industry customers. It also derives investment income from equity stakes in related technology firms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of China's earliest listed professional storage manufacturers, the company positions itself as a leading domestic自主可控 storage provider. It competes with international and domestic storage system vendors by leveraging its full-stack自主可控 technology and deep industry application expertise, especially in government and special industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 364.7 million, a 3.89% increase year-over-year, with storage system revenue doubling (+109.33%). However, it incurred a net loss of RMB 280.65 million, mainly due to goodwill impairment. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.68 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes自主可控 (independent controllability) and full-stack domestic technology integration as its core competitive advantage. Its products offer high reliability, performance, and security tailored for critical applications in AI, cloud computing, and special industries. The company also highlights its comprehensive service system and deep industry customization capabilities.
